info.title: Agentic CRM External API
info.description: Private apps, explicit object read scopes and selected properties/team access. No write scopes, public OAuth or webhooks in v1. App tokens never authorize administration. HTTPS at production ingress; 120 admissions/minute/app; opaque cursor binding includes app policy version.
